text: P75’s universal formal laws and routes of formation remain completed;
Section 16 supplies a content-sensitive interpretive connection, without exhausting independently characterized wisdom or proving that every form requires all substantive commitments of the core.
Actual formation, concern and affect, and sufficiency remain distinct parts of the full target, not additional gates imposed wholesale on the present necessity task.
A true risk bound allows actual failure; adequate response need not require a common coarsest description; formal universal quantification does not itself prove wisdom coverage.
Preserving local skill relations does not establish that the rival accepts the full core; sitting-and-forgetting is not reduced to judgment or compression.
Projection theorems do not prove that actual forgetting is beneficial.
Section 18 supplies one transformation-content connection, not an exhaustive account of sitting-and-forgetting or wisdom.
Tranquility needs no external payoff and appropriate ending requires no indefinite individual continuation.
Fidelity concerns explanatory content, not a demand that transformation preserve everything without loss.
The three common relations are not an exhaustive definition or minimal axiom list.
Content validity is not actual understanding, and explanatory fidelity does not alone prove constitutive necessity.
The old closure results supply no wisdom correspondence; full pointwise closure coverage for a finite root differs from separate coverage of basis rows.
No acquisition route is universally prescribed: chance origins may be followed by verification, direct apprehension need not use explicit calculation, and redundant grounds may substitute.
Acquired binding retains supplied meanings, categories and coverage; juxtaposing valid derivation with actual content use does not establish their joint necessity.
The all-term fidelity criterion is not a requirement that each wise episode preserve every position, and formal binding is not actual human understanding.
This round connects content dependence and path composition interpretively, without a new adapter.
Premise-free warrant for all metareasoning remains a separate goal, not an added gate here.
Section 25 rules out all-choice preservation as necessary for P103’s proved operational achievement; it neither defines that achievement as wisdom nor licenses arbitrary losses for all wisdom.
Renewed demand for a retired locus is not covered by a recovery guarantee.
Continuing revision and productive return do not alone establish content warrant or ethical purpose.
Fallible-capacity necessity neither certifies actual weights nor supplies ethical permission or a complete justification of false belief.
It does not require every wisdom claim to undertake two-sided error bounds.
The timed branch excludes different informative initial states; theoretical or contemplative content without this discrimination commitment retains its own constitutive burden.
The present-realization interface does not certify a particular experience, living reading or overall ranking.
The rest witness omits tranquil experience and does not show actual rest to be worse.
The three non-statistical branches now have substantive interpretive connections and are not left unaddressed for lacking extra output.
Their joint requirement of the full substantive core still does not follow from representability or separately suitable readings.
Complete mathematical ontology and experience generation are not added gates.
A common operational factor is not a sufficient root for all wisdom content: the original history instance agrees on every joining context despite different event words.
This bounds the question scope; the full core retains the histories.
Exact explanatory coverage is not an omniscience demand on each wise person; normative and actual correspondence obligations remain.
The adapters regroup declared content while keeping processes, actions and the same R.
Shared claim types do not establish adequate meaning; possible courses certify neither actual acquisition nor duties.
P76 determinacy and the claim-free Choosing boundary remain.
Formal joint preservation does not complete the full wisdom root.
Record non-fixation does not preserve every actual law and cannot refute the full theory.
Loop certifies neither moral superiority nor an empirical social law; counterfactual reasoning is not imposed on every theoretical, contemplative or ending achievement.
Fallible acceptance retains the existing epistemic candidate and its contestable commitments, not a derivation from G0 or an error bound alone.
The constructed archive case supplies evidential adequacy explicitly and does not identify every reasonable belief with wisdom.
False content is neither rewritten as knowledge nor automatically excused.
Structural necessity uses the complete specified test family, move/claim correspondence and branching conditions; identification uses its stated state bounds and other conditions.
Conditional laws do not make their antecedents universal.

Actual correspondence, scientific question coverage and science-wide necessity of the full constitutive core remain unestablished; no unique vocabulary is required, no ethical gap substitutes for the scientific gap, and no impossibility of the universal target is proved.
P92 proves a local necessity of structural reach, not a time-ordered causal path by answer time or the universal necessity of its mechanism representation.

The research does not predetermine proof of the strongest hypothesis as its endpoint; a theorem’s premise is not thereby necessary for every scientific achievement, and omission in a weaker description does not automatically refute the full theory.
Task-relevant restrictions need actual warrant; the source comparison neither removes conditions nor guarantees exclusion of every unknown defect, and is not empirical validation of this model.
P101 source correspondence is not a formal experiment-to-Choosing instance; the necessity concerns continuation content for the declared task, not branching-graph syntax.
Complete endpoint histories are not finite samples, and semantic tests are not physical test procedures.
The timed result has common-all-initial-state and prefix mechanism conditions; no physical duration or actual causal identification is supplied.
No necessary-and-sufficient universal demarcation criterion; science is not defined by accepting this theory, and representing all outcomes is not empirical confirmation.
The nondual correction does not itself prove normative necessity.
Repair fidelity and historical necessity alone do not refute an openly controlling end; real needs, transition losses, protective boundaries and informed harm remain.
A free normative predicate is no counterexample to fuller relational constitution, and fuller description alone is no ethical proof.
No positive weight is preassigned to every added option or every removable restriction judged to require removal.
Universal warrant and complete mixed ordering remain open;
G0/J and P89 retain their scopes.

Technical learning does not itself warrant ends; task fulfillment can change intervention without unconditionally requiring exit, and a purpose’s formation history does not automatically invalidate it.
The original fulfillment test cannot certify goodness or escape from capture: declared beneficiaries do not exhaust affected living, and harm before completion also matters.
Retaining an arrangement may be warranted; nominal revisability is not enactment.
The revised question is still an inquiry and cannot prove warrant by defining it in.
P100 treats only the constructed domain where the graver side independently decomposes into two complete equivalent activity losses; it does not calibrate the preceding arbitrary H.
No universal exchange rate, global ranking, minimum sufficient number or final two-against-two verdict follows.
Consistency with all earlier principles, general FR and zero-substantive-axiom grounding remain open, with no new independent acceptance or empirical calibration.
This case cannot dismiss CP claims or valid chances outside its warranted scope.

P102 completes a scoped account of decomposition and direct whole-course comparison, not a unique natural partition for every harm, actual certification of all aftereffects or a minimum sufficient number for arbitrary H.
Either whole reference may be unavailable; needing an upper bound does not warrant one.
Retains finite natural weights, complete inputs, a common rule and actual probability correspondence.

The native adapter adds its balance, presence and initial-record conditions; structural reach may include future or wrongly ordered edges and does not prove time-ordered transmission by answer time or successful understanding/use.
Science-wide necessity of the whole core is unproved.
P94 generalizes qualitative blindness only; it claims neither a newly formalized weighted bound nor a least-condition result.
Predictive success with an incomplete description is not an adequate rival to a complete mechanism explanation.
Equal minimum requirements fix admission only; distinct lives, histories and expressions can have equal needs.
Marginal admission does not establish joint realizability, which must itself be represented.
All-level tests may include dynamically inaccessible levels and are stronger than local fidelity on feasible courses.
Actual dependencies, a unique complete content language, constitution of changing needs, complete mixed-loss ordering and zero-substantive-axiom normative warrant are not derived.
No universal lossless-action requirement, institutional-retreat default or new empirical validation is claimed.
Completed formal laws and routes of formation do not automatically prove exhaustive wisdom coverage, universal necessity of every core commitment or sufficiency of the relations.
Actual formation, concern and affect, and historical correspondence have separate evidential burdens.
P71 has landed with its local conditions retained;
P83’s bounded identification excludes a universal perpetual-revision reading.
The pooled-registration examples cited for 明 do not require every improvement to add external information; reorganization of accessible experience is a possible route still needing explanation.
Ethical warrant belongs to Part II.
This record adds no Lean; original formal credit stays with the modules and P73/P74, and the added P83 citation is a scope check.

needs decidability (a logical commitment) and pointwise properties (in place of function extensionality)
speaks only of counts, saying neither which member enters or leaves nor anything of relations
the queue worlds have infinitely many relata, each arising once
the laws of counting in finite worlds and under enclosure are in counting-under-enclosure

read of worlds only the counting of activity is stated, the counts of standing and dependence being covered by the general counting_laws, and their laws under the premises being in counting-standing-and-dependence
the laws of counting under all eight premises and under each selection of them are given
the witnesses under the selections all have infinitely many relata, the laws under each selection in finite worlds being in counting-under-enclosure

the range includes worlds in which premises hold vacuously: in the open queue dissipation, activity needing support and bounded transmission all hold vacuously (World.openQueue_not_binds), and the whole law of counting where every premise binds is given, adding only that something arises (World.binding_counting), and the laws where the premises of each selection bind (World.binding_counting_under) and in finite worlds where every premise but the census binds (World.finite_binding_counting) are given as well, the witnesses of the former having infinitely many relata, and the laws in finite worlds where the premises of each selection bind are in counting-under-enclosure (World.finite_binding_counting_under)

binding is an instance of each condition: in the queue closed once activity needing support and bounded transmission hold whatever is active and whatever flows, and the laws under a stronger reading of binding, in which each premise excludes something the representation allows, are not stated, that reading being Ren's to choose

the webs of the queue closed once and the other witnesses are saturated, the weakest (every relatum depending on every relatum at what it stands at, Web.saturated), the lossy queue is unbalanced and the relay not embodied, and they serve only as witnesses
evaluates neither arising nor ceasing

the names (Tally, Queue, Pointwise, CountsObey, openQueue, drivenQueue, onceClosedQueue, Premise, Meets, BindsCounting, saturated, lossyQueue, relayQueue and others) are the AI's choice under Ren's naming criteria of 10 October (in the zero-axiom part, formal words describing the abstract dynamics, social and financial words not the first choice), and readings remain Ren's.
